changes_vs_iteration4: Replaced the box-conditional face code with smooth Gaussian anatomical features in normalised head coordinates: supraorbital brow ridge with glabella, deep-set orbital sockets with eyeball domes, nasal bridge, broad flat simian nose with flared alae and nostril recesses, prognathic muzzle, closed-mouth line groove, and lower-lip/chin mass.
The head now reads as a real ape face (heavy brow, dark eye sockets, broad nose, protruding muzzle) instead of a smooth mask.

Fur-volume amplitude reduced to a subtle surface texture (0.003). At higher amplitudes the sinusoidal strands wrapped badly on the cylindrical arms/legs and read as 'pleating'. Real fur clumping/direction remains the materials_fur stage's job.
Added a light post-fur relax smooth so fine fur grooves do not dominate while large facial/muscular forms stay intact.

findings.defect: Face now has brow, sockets, nose and muzzle, but is still a stylized clay ape rather than a photo-accurate match to the reference artwork's face.
findings.correction: Large improvement over iteration 4's mask; needs human check against front_reference.png.

findings.defect: Body remains a stylized generic-ape form; fur is only a faint surface texture and does not read as shaggy fur.
findings.correction: Fur is intentionally deferred to the materials_fur stage; flagged for human review.

notes: Iteration 5 focuses on the face: Gaussian brow/socket/nose/muzzle/chin features give a recognisable ape countenance with a bulging brow and deep sockets.
